appRules.name: Counter-Strike 2
appRules.title: CS2 CrossOver parity profile
rationale: CS2 on Mac needs CrossOver/GPTK-class D3DMetal, not stock Wine.
Kirito mirrors CrossOver guidance: D3DMetal on, DXVK off, MSync on, Retina off.
Launch uses -applaunch with -nojoy -novid -fullscreen and sets Wine Direct3D VideoMemorySize from system RAM.
warnings: Install CrossOver or Game Porting Toolkit with D3DMetal before expecting playable CS2.
VAC is usually fine under Wine/CrossOver, but secure-server errors can still happen if the translation layer fails.

appRules.title: Until Dawn compatibility profile
rationale: Until Dawn has a Kirito-specific AVX/Rosetta launch path, so keep the modern Metal path unless testing proves otherwise.
